f.title: Post-authorisation studies must complete clinical information and must not promote prescription
f.statement: Post-authorisation studies must aim to complete the information obtained during the clinical development of the medicine before its authorisation. Planning, conducting or funding post-authorisation studies for the purpose of promoting the prescription of medicines is prohibited.

rows.actor: Company authorised to market medicines; sponsor of post-authorisation studies
rows.quote: Los estudios post-autorización deberán tener como finalidad completar la información obtenida durante el desarrollo clínico de los medicamentos previo a su autorización. Queda prohibida la planificación, realización o financiación de estudios post autorización con la finalidad de promover la prescripción de los medicamentos.
rows.review_note: Review: actor not named in the article; applied to the company/sponsor of the study. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: deberán/queda prohibida = Mandatory.
rows.quote_en: Post-authorisation studies shall aim to complete the information obtained during the clinical development of medicines prior to their authorisation. The planning, conduct or funding of post-authorisation studies for the purpose of promoting the prescription of medicines is prohibited.

f.title: Withdraw the product from the market at own cost on preventive suspension
f.statement: Where, for public-health reasons, a preventive suspension of a medicine is imposed by reasoned resolution pending the suspension or revocation procedure, the interested party (the company) must withdraw the product from the market at its own cost, without prejudice to action by the regulatory authority when the urgency of the case requires it. The costs of these measures are borne by the interested party and are not a sanction.
f.clause: Artículo 7. Suspensión o revocación de autorización, literal e)
f.applicability: Medicines subject to a preventive suspension for public-health reasons (Article 7(e))

rows.actor: Interested party (company holding the authorisation)
rows.quote: e) Por motivos de salud pública, y hasta que se resuelva el procedimiento de suspensión O revocación, debe imponerse Una suspensión preventiva mediante resolución motivada, incluso inmediatamente antes del inicio del procedimiento. En estos casos, el interesado habrá de retirar del mercado el producto a su costa, sin perjuicio de una actuación de la autoridad reguladora cuando la urgencia del caso lo requiera. Los gastos que ocasionen estas medidas correrán a cargo del interesado, sin que ello tenga, en ningún caso, carácter sancionador.
rows.location: Artículo 7. Suspensión o revocación de autorización, literal e)
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: e) For public-health reasons, and until the suspension or revocation procedure is resolved, a preventive suspension must be imposed by reasoned resolution, even immediately before the procedure starts. In these cases, the interested party shall withdraw the product from the market at its own cost, without prejudice to action by the regulatory authority when the urgency of the case requires it. The costs arising from these measures shall be borne by the interested party, without this having, in any case, a punitive character.

f.title: Keep a detailed register of all suspected ADRs and therapeutic failures, domestic and foreign
f.statement: In accordance with the Good Pharmacovigilance Practices for the Pharmaceutical Industry, the company must keep a detailed record of all suspected adverse reactions and therapeutic failures occurring inside and outside the national territory.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Data integrity & records

rows.actor: Company authorised to market medicines (empresa autorizada para la comercialización)
rows.quote: La empresa autorizada para la comercialización de medicamentos, de conformidad con las «Buenas Prácticas de Farmacovigilancia para la Industria Farmacéutica», deberá: 9.1 Llevar un registro detallado de todas las sospechas de reacciones adversas y fallo terapéutico que se produzcan dentro y fuera del territorio nacional.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The company authorised to market medicines, in accordance with the "Good Pharmacovigilance Practices for the Pharmaceutical Industry", shall: 9.1 Keep a detailed record of all suspected adverse reactions and therapeutic failure occurring inside and outside the national territory.

f.title: Report serious domestic suspected ADRs immediately and within 15 calendar days of receipt
f.statement: The company must record and communicate to the National Pharmacovigilance Coordinating Centre immediately, and in any case within 15 calendar days following receipt of the information, all suspected serious adverse reactions occurring in the national territory that have been notified to it by health professionals, or any other suspected serious adverse reaction occurring in the country of which it can reasonably be expected to have knowledge.

rows.actor: Company authorised to market medicines (empresa autorizada para la comercialización)
rows.deadline: Immediately and in any case within 15 calendar days of receipt of the information
rows.quote: 9.2 Registrar y comunicar a El Centro Coordinador Nacional de Farmacovigilancia de forma inmediata, y en cualquier Caso dentro de los quince días calendario siguientes a la recepción de la información, todas las sospechas de reacciones adversas graves que ocurran dentro del territorio nacional y que le hayan sido notificadas por profesionales de salud o cualquier otra sospecha de reacción adversa grave que ocurra en el país y de la que puede esperarse razonablemente que tenga conocimiento.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 9.2 Record and communicate to the National Pharmacovigilance Coordinating Centre immediately, and in any case within the fifteen calendar days following receipt of the information, all suspected serious adverse reactions occurring within the national territory that have been notified to it by health professionals, or any other suspected serious adverse reaction occurring in the country of which it can reasonably be expected to have knowledge.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Serious suspected adverse reactions occurring in Guatemala

f.title: Monitor the worldwide scientific literature for ADR cases
f.statement: The company must monitor the worldwide scientific literature in order to identify published cases of adverse reactions where there is reasonable suspicion that the cause is an active substance of a medicine registered in the country.
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

rows.actor: Company authorised to market medicines (empresa autorizada para la comercialización)
rows.quote: 9.3 Realizar un seguimiento de la bibliografía científica mundial, con el fin de identificar los casos publicados de reacciones adversas, en los que existan sospechas razonables de que el causante es un principio activo de un medicamento que este registrado en el país.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 9.3 Monitor the worldwide scientific literature in order to identify published cases of adverse reactions in which there is reasonable suspicion that the cause is an active substance of a medicine registered in the country.

f.title: Ensure serious suspected ADRs from post-authorisation studies are reported
f.statement: The company must ensure that all suspected serious adverse reactions occurring during a post-authorisation study, of which it can reasonably be expected to have knowledge, are communicated.

rows.actor: Company authorised to market medicines (empresa autorizada para la comercialización)
rows.quote: 9.4 Garantizar que todas las sospechas de reacciones adversas graves que ocurran durante el transcurso de un estudio post-autorización, y de las que pueda esperarse que razonablemente tengan conocimiento, sean comunicadas.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 9.4 Ensure that all suspected serious adverse reactions occurring during the course of a post-authorisation study, and of which they can reasonably be expected to have knowledge, are communicated.

f.title: Submit periodic safety reports with a benefit-risk evaluation according to the set calendar
f.statement: The company must submit to the National Pharmacovigilance Coordinating Centre the records of all suspected adverse reactions in the form of a periodic safety report that includes a scientific evaluation of the benefits and risks associated with the medicine. The submission must follow the established calendar.

rows.actor: Company authorised to market medicines (empresa autorizada para la comercialización)
rows.quote: 9.5 Presentar a El Centro Coordinador Nacional de Farmacovigilancia los registros de todas las sospechas de reacciones adversas en forma de informe periddico de seguridad, que incluya una evaluación científica de los beneficios y riesgos asociados al medicamento. Dicha presentación deberá realizarse según calendario establecido.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 9.5 Submit to the National Pharmacovigilance Coordinating Centre the records of all suspected adverse reactions in the form of a periodic safety report, including a scientific evaluation of the benefits and risks associated with the medicine. Such submission shall be made according to the established calendar.

f.title: Conduct post-authorisation studies when needed to characterise potential risks
f.statement: The company must conduct, when required, post-authorisation studies to confirm, quantify or characterise potential risks of medicines authorised in the country.
f.processes: Epidemiology / safety studies; Risk management & minimisation

rows.actor: Company authorised to market medicines (empresa autorizada para la comercialización)
rows.quote: 9.6 Realizar, cuando se precise, estudios post-autorización para confirmar, cuantificar O caracterizar riesgos potenciales de los medicamentos autorizados en el país.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 9.6 Conduct, when required, post-authorisation studies to confirm, quantify or characterise potential risks of the medicines authorised in the country.

f.title: Immediately communicate new information that may affect the benefit-risk balance or product information
f.statement: The company must immediately communicate to the National Pharmacovigilance Coordinating Centre any new information that may influence the overall benefit-risk evaluation or may require modification of the summary of product characteristics (ficha técnica), the package leaflet or both.
f.processes: Benefit–risk review; Submission operations; Safety labeling

rows.actor: Company authorised to market medicines (empresa autorizada para la comercialización)
rows.quote:
9.7 Comunicar inmediatamente a El Centro Coordinador Nacional de Farmacovigilancia toda nueva información que pueda influir en la evaluación global de la relación beneficio-
riesgo o bien pueda requerir la modificación de la ficha técnica, prospecto o ambos.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 9.7 Immediately communicate to the National Pharmacovigilance Coordinating Centre any new information that may influence the overall evaluation of the benefit-risk balance or may require modification of the technical data sheet, the package leaflet or both.

f.title: Immediately report restrictions, suspensions or bans imposed by authorities of any country
f.statement: The company must immediately communicate to the National Pharmacovigilance Coordinating Centre any restriction, suspension or prohibition imposed by the competent authorities of any country.

rows.actor: Company authorised to market medicines (empresa autorizada para la comercialización)
rows.quote: 9.8 Comunicar de forma inmediata a El Centro Coordinador Nacional de Farmacovigilancia, cualquier restricción, suspensión o prohibición impuestas por las autoridades competentes de cualquier país.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 9.8 Immediately communicate to the National Pharmacovigilance Coordinating Centre any restriction, suspension or prohibition imposed by the competent authorities of any country.

f.title: Carry out the pharmacovigilance and risk management plans set for each medicine
f.statement: The company must carry out the pharmacovigilance and risk management plans established for each medicine, including the studies the competent authorities consider necessary to evaluate the safety of the medicine or the effectiveness of risk minimisation measures.
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Epidemiology / safety studies

rows.actor: Company authorised to market medicines (empresa autorizada para la comercialización)
rows.quote: 9.9 Llevar a cabo los planes de Farmacovigilancia y de gestión de riesgos que para cada medicamento se establezcan, incluyendo los estudios que las autoridades competentes juzguen necesarios para evaluar la seguridad del medicamento, o para evaluar la efectividad de las medidas de minimización de riesgos.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 9.9 Carry out the pharmacovigilance and risk management plans established for each medicine, including the studies that the competent authorities deem necessary to evaluate the safety of the medicine, or to evaluate the effectiveness of risk minimisation measures.

f.title: Do not communicate pharmacovigilance data to the public without authorisation; keep information objective
f.statement: The company must not communicate pharmacovigilance data on an authorised medicine to the public without authorisation from the Department. The marketing authorisation holder must ensure that the information is presented objectively and is not misleading, without omitting relevant safety information. Failure to communicate to the Department, or disseminating the information outside the stated terms, is considered non-compliance and measures will be taken to ensure compliance.

rows.actor: Company authorised to market medicines (empresa autorizada para la comercialización)
rows.quote: 9.10 No comunicar al público datos de Farmacovigilancia relativos a Un medicamento autorizado sin contar con la autorización de EL DEPARTAMENTO. El titular de la autorización de comercialización se asegurará que la información se presente de manera objetiva y no sea engañosa, sin omitir información de seguridad relevante. La falta de comunicación a El Departamento O difundir la información sin respetar los términos previstos será considerado como incumplimiento a las y se adoptarán medidas necesarias para garantizar el cumplimiento de esta obligación.
rows.review_note: Review: the sanction sentence that follows is summarised in the statement; quote kept to the duty. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: Mandatory (negative duty + se asegurará).
rows.quote_en: 9.10 Not communicate to the public pharmacovigilance data relating to an authorised medicine without the authorisation of THE DEPARTMENT. The marketing authorisation holder shall ensure that the information is presented objectively and is not misleading, without omitting relevant safety information. Failure to communicate to the Department or disseminating the information without respecting the stated terms shall be considered non-compliance with [the rules] and the measures necessary to ensure compliance with this obligation shall be adopted.

f.title: Implement in the country the regulatory safety measures and RMP measures
f.statement: The company must carry out in the country the regulatory measures adopted for safety reasons for the medicines it holds, and all measures and studies included in the risk management plan that are planned to be carried out in the country.
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Local PV interfaces

rows.actor: Company authorised to market medicines (empresa autorizada para la comercialización)
rows.quote: 9.11 Llevar a cabo en el país, las medidas reguladoras adoptadas por razones de seguridad para los medicamentos del que es titular, así como todas aquellas medidas y estudios incluidos en el plan de gestión de riesgos y que Se prevean realizar en el país.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 9.11 Carry out in the country the regulatory measures adopted for safety reasons for the medicines of which it is the holder, as well as all those measures and studies included in the risk management plan that are planned to be carried out in the country.

f.title: Establish procedures so that ADR information about promoted medicines is reported
f.statement: The company must establish appropriate procedures to comply with the duty to notify all information on the use of the medicines it promotes, especially the adverse reactions that health professionals and/or patients communicate to it.

rows.actor: Company authorised to market medicines (empresa autorizada para la comercialización)
rows.quote: 9.12 Establecer los procedimientos adecuados para que se cumpla con el deber de notificar todas las informaciones relativas a la utilización de los medicamentos que promocionan, indicando especialmente las reacciones adversas que profesionales de la salud y/o pacientes les comuniquen.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 9.12 Establish appropriate procedures so that the duty to notify all information relating to the use of the medicines they promote is complied with, indicating especially the adverse reactions that health professionals and/or patients communicate to them.

f.title: Have a permanently available qualified PV responsible person and notify their name
f.statement: The company authorised to market a medicine for human use must have, permanently and continuously, an appropriately qualified professional responsible for pharmacovigilance. The company must communicate the name of this person to the Programme for registration.
f.clause: Artículo 10. Profesional responsable del programa de farmacovigilancia

rows.actor: Company authorised to market medicines (empresa autorizada para la comercialización)
rows.quote: La empresa autorizada para la comercialización de un medicamento de uso humano deberá disponer, de manera permanente y continua, de un profesional adecuadamente calificado como responsable en materia de Farmacovigilancia. La empresa comunicará a EL PROGRAMA el nombre de este responsable para su registro.
rows.location: Artículo 10. Profesional responsable del programa de farmacovigilancia
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The company authorised to market a medicine for human use shall have, permanently and continuously, an appropriately qualified professional as the person responsible for pharmacovigilance. The company shall communicate to THE PROGRAMME the name of this person for registration.

f.title: PV responsible: maintain a system to collect, process and evaluate all suspected ADRs
f.statement: The pharmacovigilance responsible person must create and maintain a system to collect, process and evaluate information on all suspected adverse reactions notified to company staff and to medical representatives.
f.clause: Artículo 11. Funciones del profesional responsable de farmacovigilancia, 11.1
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up; Safety system configuration

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance responsible person of the company
rows.quote: El profesional responsable de Farmacovigilancia tendra las siguientes funciones: 11.1 Crear y mantener un sistema para recopilar, tratar y evaluar la información sobre todas las sospechas de reacciones adversas notificadas al personal de la empresa y a los visitadores médicos.
rows.location: Artículo 11. Funciones del profesional responsable de farmacovigilancia, 11.1
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The pharmacovigilance responsible professional shall have the following functions: 11.1 Create and maintain a system to collect, process and evaluate information on all suspected adverse reactions notified to company staff and to medical representatives.

f.title: PV responsible: prepare and submit periodic safety reports
f.statement: The pharmacovigilance responsible person must prepare and submit to the Programme the periodic safety reports referred to in article 9.5.

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance responsible person of the company
rows.quote: 11.2 Preparar y presentar al EL PROGRAMA los informes periódicos de seguridad a los que se refiere el artículo 9.5 de la presente normativa.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 11.2 Prepare and submit to THE PROGRAMME the periodic safety reports referred to in article 9.5 of this regulation.

f.title: PV responsible: respond rapidly and fully to requests for information, including sales data
f.statement: The pharmacovigilance responsible person must ensure a rapid and complete response to any request from the Programme for additional information needed to evaluate the benefits and risks of a medicine, including information on the volume of sales or prescriptions.

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance responsible person of the company
rows.quote: 11.3 Asegurar que se dé una respuesta rápida y completa a cualquier solicitud de información adicional de EL PROGRAMA, necesaria para poder evaluar los beneficios y riesgos de un medicamento, incluida la información relativa al volumen de ventas o de prescripciones del medicamento de que se trate.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 11.3 Ensure that a rapid and complete response is given to any request for additional information from THE PROGRAMME needed to evaluate the benefits and risks of a medicine, including information on the volume of sales or prescriptions of the medicine concerned.

f.title: PV responsible: provide other information relevant to benefit-risk, including PASS information
f.statement: The pharmacovigilance responsible person must provide the National Pharmacovigilance Coordinating Centre with any other information of interest for the evaluation of the benefits and risks of a medicine, including information on post-authorisation safety studies.

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance responsible person of the company
rows.quote: 11.4 Facilitar a EL Centro Coordinador nacional de Farmacovigilancia cualquier otra información de interés para la evaluación de los beneficios y riesgos asociados a un medicamento, incluida la información sobre estudios de seguridad post-autorización.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 11.4 Provide THE National Pharmacovigilance Coordinating Centre with any other information of interest for the evaluation of the benefits and risks associated with a medicine, including information on post-authorisation safety studies.

f.title: Distribute at least the product monograph to health professionals
f.statement: The marketing authorisation company is obliged to distribute to the professionals of the national public and private health network at least the monograph, together with the information established by the corresponding regulation.
f.clause: Artículo 12. Información y modificación de las condiciones de autorización por motivos de seguridad, 12.1

rows.actor: Company authorised to market medicines (empresa autorizada para la comercialización)
rows.quote: 12.1 La empresa responsable de la autorización de comercialización está obligada a difundir entre los profesionales de la red nacional de salud, pública o privada, al menos la monografía, junto con las informaciones que establece la normativa correspondiente.
rows.location: Artículo 12. Información y modificación de las condiciones de autorización por motivos de seguridad, 12.1
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 12.1 The company responsible for the marketing authorisation is obliged to distribute among the professionals of the national health network, public or private, at least the monograph, together with the information established by the corresponding regulation.

f.title: Agree safety communications to health professionals with the Programme before distribution
f.statement: When the Programme considers it necessary for the company to inform health professionals of the national public or private network about new safety data of a medicine, the company must agree the text with the Programme before its distribution.

rows.actor: Company authorised to market medicines (empresa autorizada para la comercialización)
rows.quote: 12.2 Cuando a criterio de El PROGRAMA se considere necesario que la empresa autorizada para la comercialización informe a los profesionales de la red nacional de salud, pública o privada, de nuevos datos relativos a aspectos de seguridad de un medicamento, antes de su difusión, deberá consensuar el texto previamente con El Programa.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 12.2 When, at the discretion of THE PROGRAMME, it is considered necessary for the company authorised for marketing to inform the professionals of the national health network, public or private, of new data relating to safety aspects of a medicine, before its dissemination it shall agree the text in advance with the Programme.

f.title: Update the registration dossier when relevant new safety information becomes known
f.statement: When the company becomes aware of relevant new information affecting the safety of a medicine, it must update the authorisation and registration dossier. Failure to do so may be grounds for suspension or revocation under the respective Regulation.

rows.actor: Company authorised to market medicines (empresa autorizada para la comercialización)
rows.quote: 12.3 Cuando la empresa conozca nueva información relevante que afecte la seguridad de un medicamento, deberá actualizar el expediente de autorización y registro. El incumplimiento de dicho deber podrá ser causa de suspensión o revocación, de conformidad con lo establecido en el Reglamento respectivo.
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: 12.3 When the company becomes aware of relevant new information affecting the safety of a medicine, it shall update the authorisation and registration dossier. Failure to comply with this duty may be grounds for suspension or revocation, in accordance with the respective Regulation.

f.title: Provide an updated benefit-risk evaluation report when the Programme requests it
f.statement: Whenever it considers it appropriate, the Programme may ask the company, through its pharmacovigilance responsible person, for an updated report evaluating the benefit-risk balance of the authorised medicine; the company must then provide it.

rows.actor: Company authorised to market medicines (empresa autorizada para la comercialización)
rows.quote: 12.4 Siempre que lo considere oportuno, EL PROGRAMA podrá solicitar a la empresa, a través de su responsable de Farmacovigilancia, un informe actualizado de evaluación de la relación beneficio-riesgo del medicamento autorizado para la comercialización.
rows.review_note: Review: the text gives the Programme a power to request; the company duty to provide is implied (and matches 11.3), so the row is Mandatory for the company with reduced confidence. Previously recorded as Permitted, which mislabelled the authority power as a company permission.
rows.quote_en: 12.4 Whenever it considers it appropriate, THE PROGRAMME may request from the company, through its pharmacovigilance responsible person, an updated report evaluating the benefit-risk balance of the medicine authorised for marketing.

dates.title: Guatemala Normativa 19-2009 (National PV Programme): enters into force
dates.scope: Companies authorised to market medicines in Guatemala and the National Pharmacovigilance Programme
dates.quote: La presente Norma técnica entrará en vigencia inmediatamente después de su autorización. Guatemala, 24 de Agosto de 2009
dates.quote_en: This technical standard shall enter into force immediately after its authorisation. Guatemala, 24 August 2009
dates.timing_note: In force immediately on authorisation; the only date in the text is the signature date 24 August 2009, taken as the authorisation date.
